initial_findings.current_behavior: Select Episode opened a directory picker.
initial_findings.user_impact: A non-technical user could not choose one video directly.
initial_findings.required_fix: Use an ExistingFile native video picker with the ordered video filters.

initial_findings.current_behavior: Eight internal stages and raw state names were presented as the primary workflow.
initial_findings.user_impact: The user had to understand implementation vocabulary.
initial_findings.root_cause: The dock rendered the backend state machine directly.
initial_findings.required_fix: Use a five-step progressive disclosure surface and keep technical details collapsed.

initial_findings.current_behavior: Analysis, portfolio, render-plan, authorization, QA, review, and export buttons were visible together.
initial_findings.user_impact: No clear next action and high risk of an invalid sequence.
initial_findings.root_cause: One flat vertical layout owned every action.
initial_findings.required_fix: Progressive pages with one primary action and limited secondary actions.

initial_findings.current_behavior: The user had to select an implementation mode and package directory.
initial_findings.user_impact: The normal video-first workflow was not discoverable.
initial_findings.root_cause: No local source discovery orchestration existed in the presentation layer.
initial_findings.required_fix: Discover related metadata and timing files locally; stop on ambiguity and offer a clear choice.

initial_findings.current_behavior: Raw BLOCKED and internal error codes were shown in the main status area and dialogs.
initial_findings.user_impact: The user could not understand what action was needed.
initial_findings.root_cause: Exception strings were used as user-facing copy.
initial_findings.required_fix: Map errors to Arabic guidance and retain raw details only under technical details.

initial_findings.current_behavior: Playback, frame controls, review approval, QA, and export controls occupied the same main surface.
initial_findings.user_impact: The required uninterrupted review was not visually primary.
initial_findings.root_cause: Review was implemented as another button row instead of a dedicated phase.
initial_findings.required_fix: Use a large in-app player, required full playback, then a collapsed detailed toolbar and checklist.

initial_findings.current_behavior: Long work was launched asynchronously but the visible progress contract was an internal RUNNING label.
initial_findings.user_impact: The user could not tell what was happening without reading technical state.
initial_findings.root_cause: The job thread was exposed without a user-facing progress stage.
initial_findings.required_fix: Use indeterminate progress with human-readable stage labels and a cancel action only while active.

initial_findings.current_behavior: The dock used a flat form with oversized empty areas and mixed-language labels.
initial_findings.user_impact: Poor hierarchy, clipping risk, and low confidence in the next step.
initial_findings.root_cause: No page/card hierarchy or Arabic-first copy contract.
initial_findings.required_fix: Rebuild the layout with existing SIRAJ dark panels, RTL, cards, spacing, and Arabic labels.
